purpose: Teach: 完売/手形/再販/増収/不問/別個/特産/海苔

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 限定品、本日完売しましたね
lines.en: The limited edition sold out today.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact delivery. Quick, efficient pace. Slight upward inflection on the close—reporting a fact with understated satisfaction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の手形管理表を更新しました
lines.en: Yes. I've updated the VIP customer account records.
lines.style: Calm, competent. Steady rhythm without rushing. Slightly formal register—the tone of someone confirming completion of a task with quiet reliability.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 人気商品の再販を発表しましょう
lines.en: Let's announce the reissue of the popular items.
lines.style: Forward momentum, light decisiveness. Clear attack on the opening. Warm but businesslike—a suggestion being offered, not imposed. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。前期比増収のお知らせを準備しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm preparing the announcement about the revenue increase compared to last period.
lines.style: Steady, detail-oriented. Measured pace. The tone of someone working through logistics with care. Slight emphasis on 'preparing'—showing progress without rushing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 応募者の学歴は不問としましょう
lines.en: Let's not require educational background from applicants.
lines.style: Thoughtful, inclusive tone. Slight pause before the statement—considering. Spoken with quiet conviction, not defensiveness. The weight of a good decision being made.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新企画を別個のチームで進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll move the new project forward with a separate team.
lines.style: Acknowledging and organizing. Even pace, no hesitation. Practical confidence—the tone of someone turning a decision into action.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 地域の特産食品を扱う部門を作りましょう
lines.en: Let's create a division focused on local specialty foods.
lines.style: Energized but grounded. Crisp opening on 'create.' Vision-forward tone without being breathless. Collaborative in feel—inviting partnership in the idea.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海苔の卸業者と契約しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already contracted with the nori wholesaler.
lines.style: Satisfied completion. Slight emphasis on 'already'—showing initiative. Warm and direct. The tone of someone who anticipated the next step and delivered it.
